articles.title: Vault: the numbers behind it
articles.brief: Why tenant-owned cloud storage matters: how document loss affects renters in disputes; source: legal-aid guidance on record-keeping + eviction-defense outcomes.

articles.title: Vault: what it does and how to use it
articles.brief: What the Vault is — the tenant's own cloud folder (Dropbox/Google Drive) where Semptify stores their documents, not on Semptify servers. Example: tenant uploads a photo of a leak + the landlord's text, both land in their own drive.
